name: Pre-holiday window
tagline: Own TQQQ for the three sessions before every scheduled NYSE holiday, halved when 20-day volatility is high, and sit in BIL otherwise.
summary: Tests the classic pre-holiday drift at 3x: 72 scheduled-holiday windows, 10.7% of sessions in TQQQ, with a trailing realised-vol gate. The average three-session window returns +0.49% but is indistinguishable from a random window of the same length, and five of the 72 windows contribute more log return than the whole sample.
caveat: Dev CAGR is 31.9 points below TQQQ and the per-window return sits at the 43.5th percentile of a 4,000-draw random-window null, so any real pre-holiday premium is an order of magnitude too small to pay for owning only 10.7% of sessions.
